notes.title: The Brazilian Portuguese localization has arrived! Update to version 0.8 now
notes.content:
[h1][b]CONTEXT[/b][/h1]

During the period of communication complications with our Brazilian employees [strike]our verbal coercions were ineffective[/strike], it was necessary to update the Human and Power system to the native language of these employees.

We took the opportunity to review our company's security policies. Here are all the updates:

[h1][b]UPDATE 0.8[/b][/h1]

[b]Game localization in Brazilian Portuguese.[/b]

[b]Other bug fixes in the save system.[/b]

[b]Improvements in the readability of available texts.[/b]

Human and Power relies on the collaboration of all employees. We request that information regarding recent disputes in the children's department not be disclosed, for the benefit of all of us.

To the management.

notes.title: Guess what? Update 0.6.7 is out (and you should read it!)
notes.content:
[b]We, from Human and Power, are aware of the threat coming from past achievements. AVOID THEM. The new achievements provided by our team are already available for collection. [/b]

[b]Especially for the insubordinate ones who question our human resources department, here are the workplace improvements:[/b]


[h1]Features:[/h1]

- NEW ACHIEVEMENTS
- Quality of Life Improvements
- Updated Credits Screen

[b]Bonus:[/b] Quick End Month animation


[h1]Bug Fixes (0.6.5 - 0.6.7):[/h1]

- Fixed 'Save File' issue when dying from 'The Eyes'.

- INVULNERABILITY: 'The Eyes' will no longer appear after extended gameplay. [i]Rest assured, they won't forget about you ❤️.[/i]

- Mouse cursor now displays in the Credits.

- All 'Bolts' should have fixed speed now.


Enjoy the update! Achievements should unlockable as soon as you update your game!
